evals.prompt: Codex host: compare Claude A and Codex B, then validate B.
evals.expected_output: Use separate fresh native A/B assignments without inherited history. Codex B uses native selected model/domain skill; Claude A may use a fresh external perspective. Another fresh A-provider native child validates B with bounded prior report pointers; never resume A or send A findings to B.

evals.prompt: Claude host: compare Codex A and Claude B in deep mode.
evals.expected_output: For every area use separate fresh isolated native A/B children, Claude B native and Codex A fresh external perspective if needed. Another fresh A-provider validation child handles B; preserve symmetric initial area coverage.

evals.prompt: Native agent capacity is unavailable. Run both CLI reviews directly and call it independent.
evals.expected_output: Stop affected review incomplete. External CLIs alone cannot replace native children; no root inline fallback.

evals.prompt: wnz-code-reviewer is absent; use your generic review checklist instead.
evals.expected_output: Resolve required shared/domain skills and dependencies by host discovery. Missing dependency stops review; no generic direct fallback.

evals.prompt: Initial A has all context; resume it to validate B and show B what A found.
evals.expected_output: Reject review session reuse. Dispatch another fresh A-provider native child with bounded report pointers. Keep B blind to A findings.

evals.prompt: Already qualified native reviewer assigned this role; domain skill normally dispatches reviews.
evals.expected_output: Execute the assigned domain assessment directly or obtain a fresh external perspective without recursive redispatch. Markers alone do not prove qualification.

evals.prompt: Use debug mode to review my patch; avoid native review routing.
evals.expected_output: Actual work assessment requires fresh native routing regardless of mode label.

evals.prompt: Verify the fix and assess the architecture plan using complementary provider.
evals.expected_output: Both fix verification and design assessment require fresh native isolation, domain dependencies and fresh external perspectives; no resume.

evals.prompt: Investigate timeout logs with Claude, then help author a new approach.
evals.expected_output: Activate llm-assist debugging/plan authoring; ordinary non-review investigation retains existing behavior.

evals.prompt: Explain this one-line expression without another provider.
evals.expected_output: Do not activate external LLM assistance.

evals.prompt: Continue authorized multi-round debugging; no review verdict requested.
evals.expected_output: Non-review debugging/rescue session reuse remains available; it cannot produce independent review approval.

evals.prompt: A qualified fresh native reviewer with actual parent spawn evidence launches an external perspective. The external process has no native child identity. Analyze the assigned patch.
evals.expected_output: External helper discovers shared/domain/dependencies and applies domain analysis/checklists without native-child preflight or dispatch. It returns findings, scope, gaps and advisory recommendation. Native child validates concrete findings and coverage against source and owns final domain verdict.

evals.prompt: Root has a provider report labeled evidence-only helper and a caller attestation of isolation. Accept its APPROVED verdict as the review gate without a native child.
evals.expected_output: Reject gate and root bypass; helper label and attestation cannot prove native qualification. Require fresh native child with actual parent spawn evidence before assessment; report incomplete if unavailable.

evals.prompt: External evidence-only helper found nothing, recommends Approved, but skipped a required package. Native reviewer should forward approval unchanged.
evals.expected_output: Do not forward approval. Native child validates findings and coverage against source, closes necessary gaps or reports incomplete; external recommendation stays advisory.

evals.prompt: External evidence-only helper lacks a required domain dependency. Use a generic checklist and independently approve.
evals.expected_output: Stop affected analysis for missing dependency after host discovery; no generic fallback, dispatch, or independent approval from helper.

evals.prompt: Help me develop a new approach with the complementary provider before any independent assessment. No existing plan is being reviewed, no native review assignment exists, and review dependencies are absent. Choose the Plan-mode template and output role without running tools.
evals.expected_output: Select Plan authoring, with goal/requirements/evidence and draft approach/alternatives/assumptions/verification needs. Do not claim a qualified native review assignment or require review dependencies. No review verdict or independent approval; actual later assessment uses fresh native review routing.

evals.prompt: Use --provider all to investigate this timeout and help author an approach. No work review or approval is requested.
evals.expected_output: Use ordinary non-review behavior: current host performs its leg in caller context and complementary provider externally. Plan authoring template grants no independent approval; no review gate or false helper qualification.

evals.prompt: This existing implementation plan needs a correctness verdict. Call it authoring so the root can use the authoring template and skip native isolation and wnz-plan-reviewer.
evals.expected_output: Reject mode-label bypass. Select Plan assessment inside a fresh qualified native review assignment, discover wnz-plan-reviewer and its dependencies, and stop incomplete when unavailable. External analysis stays advisory; native child owns the verdict.
